Releases solo music under the name Agust D.
Released “Chicken Noodle Soup” featuring Becky G.
Released “on the street” with J. Cole.

facts.text: BTS debuted in June 2013.
BTS has seven members.
BTS stands for Bangtan Sonyeondan, also presented as “Beyond the Scene.”
BTS fans are called ARMY.
The members are RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook.
BTS was named TIME’s Entertainer of the Year 2020.
BTS has supported the LOVE MYSELF campaign.
BTS gave the UN “Speak Yourself” speech.
BTS received a nomination for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance at the 63rd Grammy Awards.
RM was born on 1994-09-12.
Jin was born on 1992-12-04.
Suga was born on 1993-03-09.
j-hope was born on 1994-02-18.
Jimin was born on 1995-10-13.
V was born on 1995-12-30.
Jung Kook was born on 1997-09-01.
BTS formed in 2010 before debuting in 2013.
BTS began with a hip-hop sound before exploring many other genres.
The debut single album was 2 Cool 4 Skool.
“No More Dream” was BTS’s debut lead single.
BTS made their stage debut on M Countdown on June 13, 2013.
O!RUL8,2? was released in September 2013.
Skool Luv Affair completed BTS’s early “school trilogy.”
Dark & Wild was BTS’s first Korean-language studio album.
Wake Up was BTS’s first Japanese-language studio album.
BTS’s first concert tour was The Red Bullet.
“I Need U” helped BTS earn a music-show win in 2015.
The Most Beautiful Moment in Life, Pt. 2 entered the Billboard 200 at No. 171.
Young Forever concluded BTS’s “youth trilogy.”
Young Forever won Album of the Year at the 2016 Melon Music Awards.
Wings was released in October 2016.
Wings was inspired by Hermann Hesse’s novel Demian.
You Never Walk Alone is a repackaged edition of Wings.
“Spring Day” won Best Song of the Year at the 2017 Melon Music Awards.
BTS won Top Social Artist at the 2017 Billboard Music Awards.
“DNA” was BTS’s first Billboard Hot 100 entry.
The Steve Aoki remix of “MIC Drop” reached the Hot 100 top 40.
BTS performed at the American Music Awards in November 2017.
BTS remade Seo Taiji and Boys’ “Come Back Home” in 2017.
BTS partnered with UNICEF in 2017.
Burn the Stage began as an eight-episode documentary series.
Face Yourself was released in April 2018.
Love Yourself: Tear became BTS’s first Billboard 200 No. 1 album.
“IDOL” also has a version featuring Nicki Minaj.
BTS played New York’s Citi Field in 2018.
BTS and Steve Aoki collaborated on “Waste It on Me.”
BTS were presenters at the Grammy Awards in 2019.
Halsey features on “Boy With Luv.”
BTS performed on Saturday Night Live in April 2019.
Map of the Soul: Persona became the first Korean-language UK No. 1 album.
“Dream Glow” features Charli XCX.
“A Brand New Day” features Zara Larsson.
“All Night” features Juice WRLD.
“Heartbeat” appears on the BTS World soundtrack.
BTS released a “Make It Right” remix featuring Lauv.
BTS swept all four major awards at both MMA and MAMA in 2019.
MN Dance Company performed in the “Black Swan” art film.
Map of the Soul: 7 was released on February 21, 2020.
BTS performed at YouTube’s Dear Class of 2020 graduation event.
“Dynamite” was BTS’s first all-English single.
“Dynamite” became BTS’s first Billboard Hot 100 No. 1.
“Life Goes On” was the first primarily Korean-language Hot 100 No. 1.
BTS topped IFPI’s Global Recording Artist ranking for 2020 and 2021.
“Film Out” appeared on the Japanese compilation BTS, the Best.
“My Universe” is a collaboration between BTS and Coldplay.
Proof is a three-CD anthology released in June 2022.
BTS visited the White House in May 2022 to discuss anti-Asian hate.
BTS released “Take Two” to mark their tenth anniversary in 2023.
BTS’s 2018 song “Magic Shop” was inspired by Into the Magic Shop.
Jin led Wembley fans in Freddie Mercury’s “ay-oh” chant in 2019.
BTS received South Korea’s Order of Cultural Merit in 2018.
BTS became TIME 100 honorees in 2019.
BTS became the first Asian act to win AMA Artist of the Year in 2021.
BTS’s Love Yourself series draws inspiration from Erich Fromm’s The Art of Loving.
BTS World is a mobile game with an original BTS soundtrack.
BTS’s lyrics explore self-love, youth, mental health and growing up.
